askovo.first_task: askovo decide start --input task.json && askovo decide status TASK_ID && askovo decide brief TASK_ID --format md
askovo.evidence: Review source refs and unresolved gaps. Collection and local demos are not demand validation.
limitations: public recruitment requires a separate authorized path
external deployment and real participation require independent receipts
new source material is not canonical evidence

prerequisites: named account and channel authorization for writes
growovo.first_task: mkt growth intake --repo /path/to/repository --slug owner/repo --read-metrics --out intake-goal.json && mkt growth start --file intake-goal.json && mkt growth run SERVICE_ID --action diagnose-product --by "$USER"
growovo.evidence: Separate action receipts, interactions, activation and retention. The first task never posts automatically.
limitations: owner authorization is not platform permission
seven-day operations and external adoption require real evidence
preview and manual handoff are not execution

prerequisites: accessible local agent logs or supplier records
a Canonical Task Economics case with complete costs and buyer acceptance for tool-value comparison
